name: monthly_gmv_mom_growth
question: 按月统计已签收商品 GMV，并给出相对上月的环比增长率；只返回 2017-02 的结果。
sql: WITH monthly AS (SELECT substr(purchase_timestamp, 1, 7) AS month, SUM(price) AS delivered_gmv FROM product_sales WHERE order_status = 'delivered' GROUP BY month), compared AS (SELECT month, delivered_gmv, LAG(delivered_gmv) OVER (ORDER BY month) AS previous_gmv FROM monthly) SELECT month, ROUND(delivered_gmv, 2) AS delivered_gmv, ROUND((delivered_gmv - previous_gmv) * 100.0 / previous_gmv, 2) AS mom_growth_pct FROM compared WHERE month = '2017-02'

name: top_category_each_year
question: 分别找出 2017 年和 2018 年已签收 GMV 最高的商品类别及金额，每年只保留第一名。
sql: WITH category_year AS (SELECT substr(purchase_timestamp, 1, 4) AS year, category_name, SUM(price) AS delivered_gmv FROM product_sales WHERE order_status = 'delivered' AND substr(purchase_timestamp, 1, 4) IN ('2017', '2018') GROUP BY year, category_name), ranked AS (SELECT year, category_name, delivered_gmv, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY year ORDER BY delivered_gmv DESC, category_name) AS rank_number FROM category_year) SELECT year, category_name, ROUND(delivered_gmv, 2) AS delivered_gmv FROM ranked WHERE rank_number = 1 ORDER BY year

name: delivery_sla_by_customer_state
question: 按客户州统计已签收订单的按时送达率，只保留至少 1000 个有配送结果订单的州，并列出按时率最高的前五名。
sql: SELECT customer_state, COUNT(delivered_on_time) AS measured_orders, ROUND(AVG(delivered_on_time) * 100, 2) AS on_time_delivery_pct FROM order_delivery_metrics GROUP BY customer_state HAVING COUNT(delivered_on_time) >= 1000 ORDER BY on_time_delivery_pct DESC, measured_orders DESC LIMIT 5

name: payment_value_share
question: 列出各支付方式的支付金额及其占全部支付金额的百分比，按金额降序排列。
sql: SELECT payment_type, payment_value, ROUND(payment_value * 100.0 / SUM(payment_value) OVER (), 2) AS payment_share_pct FROM payment_type_summary ORDER BY payment_value DESC, payment_type

name: repeat_customer_rate
question: 下过两次及以上订单的复购消费者占所有下单消费者的百分比是多少？同时返回复购人数和消费者总数。
sql: SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN order_count >= 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS repeat_customers, COUNT(*) AS total_customers, ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN order_count >= 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*), 4) AS repeat_customer_pct FROM customer_order_summary

name: category_average_order_value
question: 按商品类别计算已签收订单的平均客单价，定义为该类别 GMV 除以包含该类别的去重订单数，列出前十名。
sql: SELECT category_name, order_count, delivered_gmv, ROUND(delivered_gmv / order_count, 2) AS category_average_order_value FROM category_sales_summary WHERE order_count > 0 ORDER BY category_average_order_value DESC, category_name LIMIT 10

name: customer_seller_state_cross_gmv
question: 统计客户州和卖家州组合的已签收 GMV，列出 GMV 最高的十个州组合。
sql: SELECT customer_state, seller_state, ROUND(SUM(price), 2) AS delivered_gmv FROM product_sales WHERE order_status = 'delivered' GROUP BY customer_state, seller_state ORDER BY delivered_gmv DESC, customer_state, seller_state LIMIT 10

name: delivery_review_comparison
question: 比较按时送达与超时送达订单的平均评价分和去重订单数。
sql: SELECT CASE WHEN odm.delivered_on_time = 1 THEN 'on_time' ELSE 'late' END AS delivery_group, COUNT(DISTINCT odm.order_id) AS order_count, ROUND(AVG(r.review_score), 4) AS average_review_score FROM order_delivery_metrics odm JOIN reviews r ON r.order_id = odm.order_id WHERE odm.delivered_on_time IS NOT NULL GROUP BY delivery_group ORDER BY delivery_group

name: monthly_cancellation_rate
question: 按月计算订单取消率，只保留订单数至少 100 的月份，并列出取消率最高的前五个月。
sql: SELECT substr(purchase_timestamp, 1, 7) AS month, COUNT(*) AS order_count, SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'canceled' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS canceled_orders, ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'canceled' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*), 4) AS cancellation_pct FROM orders GROUP BY month HAVING COUNT(*) >= 100 ORDER BY cancellation_pct DESC, month LIMIT 5

name: top_product_gmv_share
question: 找出已签收 GMV 最高的十个商品，并计算每个商品占全部已签收 GMV 的百分比。
sql: WITH product_gmv AS (SELECT product_id, SUM(price) AS delivered_gmv FROM product_sales WHERE order_status = 'delivered' GROUP BY product_id) SELECT product_id, ROUND(delivered_gmv, 2) AS delivered_gmv, ROUND(delivered_gmv * 100.0 / SUM(delivered_gmv) OVER (), 4) AS gmv_share_pct FROM product_gmv ORDER BY delivered_gmv DESC, product_id LIMIT 10

name: category_freight_to_gmv_ratio
question: 已签收订单中，各商品类别的运费占 GMV 比例是多少？只保留 GMV 超过 10 万的类别并列出比例最高的前十名。
sql: SELECT category_name, delivered_gmv, freight_value, ROUND(freight_value * 100.0 / delivered_gmv, 4) AS freight_to_gmv_pct FROM category_sales_summary WHERE delivered_gmv > 100000 ORDER BY freight_to_gmv_pct DESC, category_name LIMIT 10

name: delivered_customer_gmv_p99
question: 所有至少有一笔已签收订单的消费者中，累计已签收 GMV 的第 99 百分位门槛是多少？
sql: WITH ranked AS (SELECT delivered_gmv, CUME_DIST() OVER (ORDER BY delivered_gmv) AS cumulative_pct FROM customer_order_summary WHERE delivered_order_count >= 1) SELECT ROUND(MIN(delivered_gmv), 2) AS delivered_customer_gmv_p99 FROM ranked WHERE cumulative_pct >= 0.99
